regions.region: title and abstract summary reaction graphic
regions.finding: General graphical summary of the current paper's double arylation and monoarylation reaction classes; generic R/Ar structures, not a discrete experimental row.
Generic Heck and Sonogashira background equations; no current-paper experiment was created.
Prior-literature reaction of organic halides with nonterminal alkynes, explicitly cited as earlier work; not a current-paper reported experiment.

regions.finding: Mechanistic/regioselectivity comparison containing a reported-protocol pathway and proposed intermediates A/B; it is not a discrete current-paper experiment.

regions.region: upper-right Table 1 reaction header, eight rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight independent optimization experiments for 1a + PhI were extracted row by row. Shared 5 mol% Pd(PPh3)4, 5 mol% Ag2CO3, K2CO3 (4 equiv), N2 and PhI (1 equiv) were applied to their rows; entry 6 omits Ag2CO3 per footnote b. Yields are isolated and based on PhI.

Narrative duplicates optimization results, states that no monophenylation product was detected at room temperature, and provides no additional independent experiment. It calls the 6% toluene result entry 4 although the visible table lists it as entry 1; the discrepancy is retained.

unresolved: The exact amount of allene 1a is not printed in Table 1; the prose only says that an excess was required.
The prose/table entry-number discrepancy for the 6% toluene result requires external review.
No explicitly associated SI was provided, so setup, workup, purification and characterization details remain missing.

regions.region: upper-left Table 2 reaction header, eight rows, and scale footnote
regions.finding: Eight substrate-scope rows were inspected. Table 2 entry 1 is the same 1a/PhI, DMF, 80 °C, 3 h, 87% experiment as Table 1 entry 5 and was merged with cross-page evidence; entries 2-8 are separate records. The 0.3-0.6 mmol footnote was preserved as a range rather than an exact row scale.

regions.region: middle-left Scheme 2 reaction header and three rows
regions.finding: Three separate monoarylation scope experiments (1d, 1e and 1g) were extracted. The third row intentionally yields product 3a because substrate 1g already contains a phenyl substituent; it remains separate from the double-arylation route to 3a.
ORTEP/X-ray characterization of 4a, not a new reaction experiment.

regions.region: lower-right conclusion and Supporting Information Available statement
regions.finding: Conclusion summarizes double versus monoarylation. The paper states that SI existed online, but no SI file was explicitly supplied or associated in this workspace, so it was not inferred or imported.

unresolved: Scheme 2 prose says substrates 1d-g, but the visible scheme lists only 1d, 1e and 1g; no 1f row was invented.
Scheme 2 does not specify the yield measurement basis.
The Table 2 scale is a 0.3-0.6 mmol range and does not establish the exact scale for any individual row.
No explicitly associated SI was provided, so detailed procedures and characterization remain missing.
